decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is the flagship of the firm's announced precast-automation direction, has absorbed substantial development investment, and had only one year on the market, so weak early sales can still be put down to long capital-goods sales cycles and the construction downturn.

The de-shuttering robot shares core technology with the combined system and is publicly presented as part of the robot line, so dropping it would undercut earlier commitments while freeing few resources.

The profile storage robot is a supporting module for the robotic shuttering cell, and management would keep it to offer a complete system and to justify the line's investment, even though it is somewhat less central.

The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's automation strategy and is visibly marketed, and any disappointing results so far would be attributed to temporary market weakness in construction rather than to the product itself.
